notes: This is an unverified local configuration template, not a tested Cityline adapter.
Replace empty URLs/selectors only after inspecting the actual official pages. Account setup validates account configuration first and does not require an unobserved ballotUrl.
The supported signup shape creates an account only at accountSubmit. Set accountCreationTrigger to accountSubmit only after observing and verifying this exact behavior.

accountOpenDialog is only the verified navbar action that opens the email dialog. Set accountOpenDialogIsNonConsequential true only after confirming it neither sends OTP nor creates an account or accepts terms; keep it separate from the actual accountSendOtp action inside the dialog.

Each configured send-OTP, OTP-input, and separate verify-OTP operation needs its corresponding NonConsequential flag to be true after verification that it neither creates an account nor accepts terms. Unknown semantics block the driver before launch.

A separate accountVerifyOtp button requires an accountVerified marker distinct from accountSuccess. Optional accountDetailsUrl refills account contact fields after this non-creating verification. accountInitialEmail overrides the initial email selector if needed.

When the OTP page hides the initial email input, accountEmailIdentity may identify visible static email text. Submit guards compare it to this participant and reject changed identity; input and static text must both match when both are visible. Details fields that need filling still require real input selectors.

After account completion, missing ballot configuration blocks only the ballot phase. A retry within the preserved original session rechecks ballot configuration without recreating the account; a lost session requires manual recovery.

Iframe, popup, multiple-OTP or auto-creating OTP flows may require further code adaptation. The 2026-10-28 manual account completion does not verify the driver's actual OTP DOM or account-creation semantics.
A pre-existing logged-in page requires accountIdentity whose visible text exactly matches this participant's email; a generic avatar is insufficient.

If new password creation is required, the user completes password entry, confirmation and account submission in the local page. The driver observes accountSuccess and checks accountIdentity; it does not click final account submission after password entry.
Terms may be a selector string or an array of checkbox selectors; all are checked manually in the local browser.
CaptchaComplete is an optional verified visible success marker. Without one, manual completion is user-reported; actual form acceptance remains authoritative.

Browser interception checks initial requests actually delivered to Playwright route; the default accepted origin scope is Cityline HTTPS. allowTurnstileResources defaults false; verified explicit opt-in narrowly allows exact https://challenges.cloudflare.com scripts, child frames and component-internal resource requests under the current Cityline page.

Visible main-frame/new-window requests are checked against Cityline HTTPS, and navigation observers stop out-of-scope pages. Visible requests with unknown frame context or other external origins are rejected; this option does not alter CSP or browser security, process challenge tokens, or solve CAPTCHA for the user.

Playwright route may see only the first URL in a redirect chain. Visible-request checks and post-commit navigation observation are not a network firewall or pre-request egress isolation for every redirect hop.

Keep verified false until the phase to execute and its action semantics are reviewed against the actual site. US +1 and DuoPlus SMS compatibility, and whether this ballot requires an account, are not established by this template.
